passed_tests: === Login Page Tests (All passed) ===
Login page has modern dark design (background: rgb(15, 23, 41))
Sign In / Sign Up tabs visible
Demo credentials button fills form with admin@nexusops.io / admin123
Login with admin credentials works correctly and redirects to dashboard
=== Backend API Tests (20/24 passed, 4 skipped due to data state) ===
POST /api/auth/login - authentication works
GET /api/networking/sites - returns sites list
GET /api/networking/stats - returns global stats
POST /api/networking/sites - creates new site with controller URL, API key, WAN details
PUT /api/networking/sites/{id} - updates site info
GET /api/networking/sites/{id}/overview - returns site details with devices, clients, health
POST /api/networking/sites/{id}/test-connection - tests UniFi controller connection
POST /api/networking/sites/{id}/adopt-device - creates device with name, MAC, type, model
PUT /api/networking/devices/{id} - updates device (name, IP, status)
DELETE /api/networking/devices/{id} - removes device
DELETE /api/networking/sites/{id} - removes site and cascades delete to devices
GET /api/invoices - returns invoices list
GET /api/clients - returns clients for move-to-client feature
POST /api/invoices/{id}/move-client - moves invoice to different client
POST /api/invoices/{id}/void - voids/cancels invoice with reason
POST /api/invoices/{id}/record-payment - supports 9 payment methods
GET /api/settings/xero - returns default Xero settings
PUT /api/settings/xero - updates Xero configuration
POST /api/xero/webhook - webhook endpoint accessible

Networking page loads with sites list and 7 global stats (Sites, Devices, Clients, APs, Switches, Gateways, Health)

WAN/LAN/WLAN health cards visible with healthy badges
Edit Site button opens pre-filled site form
Adopt Device button opens dialog with Name, MAC, Type, Model fields
Devices tab shows device cards with CPU, MEM, Uptime, edit/delete buttons
Clients tab shows client list table
=== Invoice Page Frontend Tests (All passed) ===

Invoice detail view shows line items, payment status, actions panel
Record Manual Payment dialog shows 9 payment methods: Cash, Bank Transfer/EFT, Check/Cheque, Credit Card (Offline), Debit Card, PayPal, Cryptocurrency, Wire Transfer, Other
Move to Different Client button opens dialog with client selector
Move Invoice button changes the client assignment
Void Invoice button opens confirmation with reason field
Void Invoice marks invoice as 'cancelled'
=== Sidebar Navigation Tests (All passed) ===
Networking link visible under INFRASTRUCTURE section with icon
Invoices link visible under BUSINESS section
